answer:
The scientist at MIT who won the Queen Elizabeth Prize for Engineering in 2013 was Sir Tim Berners-Lee, recognized for his work on the World Wide Web.

To answer your question about his father:
**Tim Berners-Lee's father is Christopher Berners-Lee.** He worked as a journalist, editor, and broadcaster. He also served as the editor of the BBC News website and was a long-time editor at The Spectator magazine.
